subject: SpectraLabs SDK & auth + model-routing: proposed config and quick wins
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@spectralabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SpectraLabs SDK & auth + model-routing: proposed config and quick wins

Hi Ana,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and clear priorities. Per our notes, I summarized the recommended next steps and a minimal configuration we can deliver for the PoC to validate latency, cost, and reranker quality. TL;DR: we can ship SDK + ephemeral auth keys tomorrow, start a region-aware routing policy for US-only traffic, and enable an embeddings->reranker flow as a fallback chain for long documents.

Action items / proposed scope for PoC (week 1):
- SDK: distribute our Node and Python SDK examples with a minimal wrapper for structured tool-calling (see attached snippet).
- Auth: issue short-lived API keys scoped to the PoC project; support IP allowlist and token rotation.
- Routing policy: region: us-primary (west) -> fallback: us-secondary (east) -> fallback-model: smaller/cheaper quantized variant after cost threshold.
- Embeddings & rerank: use text-embedding-3-small for candidate generation; run a lightweight neural reranker only when document count > 50 (to control cost).

Quick wins we can deliver within 48 hours:
1) SDK auth sample + ephemeral key setup (Ben will cut the snippet).
2) Initial routing_policy_v1.yaml for your infra to review.
3) Example structured-output payload for the tool calling pattern you asked about.

Attachments: SpectraLabs_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (you mentioned sending that), sdk_auth_snippet.txt (example payload), routing_policy_v1.yaml (draft routing policy).

Please let us know if any of the PoC constraints need to be tightened (data residency, longer key TTLs, etc.). If this looks good we'll follow up with a short implementation plan and a proposed kickoff slot (May 4 or May 5).

Best,
Lukas
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@spectralabs.io>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@spectralabs.io
Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SpectraLabs SDK & auth + model-routing: proposed config and quick wins

Thanks Lukas — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff: 

1) Data residency: For the PoC, all inference must remain in US regions and logs must not leave our VPC. Can you confirm that the region routing you proposed (west -> east) will keep KV cache and logs in-region? If not, we need a private deployment option.

2) Embeddings + reranker: good approach. Two asks: (a) can you share approximate token/unit cost delta if we enable reranker only for >50 docs vs always? (b) is the reranker compatible with our existing BM25 pipeline — we want to do a hybrid flow.

3) Tool-calling/structured output: please include an example JSON schema for the tool response and a minimal SDK call showing how to surface tool results in the UI — our frontend lead asked for a concrete payload.

Attached is our internal security questionnaire (SpectraLabs_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — we also redacted a few items; procurement will send the formal PO if legal looks good. Can you confirm you can deliver ephemeral scoped keys + IP allowlist for the PoC? Also please confirm SLA expectations for PoC throughput (we'll start small: <= 50 RPS peak).

Cheers,
Ana
Head of Product
SpectraLabs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@spectralabs.io>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SpectraLabs SDK & auth + model-routing: proposed config and quick wins

Hi Ana — quick follow-up with concrete answers and a config draft. 

1) Region / residency: For hosted PoC we can constrain routing to US regions only. KV cache and token-level logs remain in the region selected; for additional guarantees we can deploy a Private (VPC) connector for your environment — that's a week longer. For the PoC we'll pin to us-west-2 and us-east-1 as failover; no logs leave those regions.

2) Embeddings + reranker cost delta (approx):
- Candidate generation (text-embedding-3-small): ~0.0008 USD per embedding (avg doc 300 tokens => 1 embedding).
- Lightweight neural reranker (per pairwise compare) ~0.0010 USD per compare.
Design: do reranker only when doc_count > 50. For a 100-doc search, hybrid flow (BM25 shortlist 200 -> embeddings shortlist 50 -> rerank top 10) expected to cost ~35% less than always reranking the full 200. We'll include a small cost calculator.

3) Tool-calling payload: attached sdk_auth_snippet.txt includes a minimal Node sample showing function signatures and a structured JSON response schema. Example snippet (inline):

-----BEGIN SNIPPET-----
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "input": "Summarize and extract invoices",
  "tool_calls": ["extract_invoice"],
  "tool_schema": {"extract_invoice": {"type":"object","properties": {"invoice_id": {"type":"string"}, "amount": {"type":"number"}}}}
}
-----END SNIPPET-----

4) Auth: we will generate ephemeral API keys scoped to the PoC project (TTL: 24h) and provide an IP allowlist model. For longer-lived integrations we can set up KMS-backed keys or facilitate a Private deployment.

Next steps (I propose):
- We push routing_policy_v1.yaml to your shared Drive for inline comments by EOD.
- Lukas will send the structured-output JSON schema and sample SDK call to your frontend (Ana).
- If procurement confirms PO, we’ll circulate a one-page SOW and a DocuSign link.

Attachments: routing_policy_v1.yaml, sdk_auth_snippet.txt

Best,
Ben
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Ben/Lukas — this looks good and aligns with our requirements. Procurement is ready to issue a PoC PO once we get the one-page SOW + DocuSign. Also:

- Security: I reviewed the questionnaire; two items to confirm in the SOW: log retention <= 30 days for PoC, and no third-party analytics.
- Kickoff: May 5 (10:00 PT) works for our engineering and frontend leads.

Please send the SOW and DocuSign link and we’ll route it internally. I attached the PO sign request (POC-signature-request.pdf) for procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Ana
Head of Product
SpectraLabs
